newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile aluminum bids range $600-$1,612.60/ST.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile aluminum bids range $600-$1,612.60/ST.

text.p: Bids for the upcoming offering of surplus aluminum ranged between $600 a short ton (30 cents a lb) and $1,612.60 a ton (80.63 cents a lb).
Cecilia Petrie was the low bidder, while the high bidder was Allied Deals Inc.

Other bidders include Wise Metals, Trans-World, Metal Exchange, Dominion Metal, F&S International, Alcan Aluminium, Reynolds Metals, Glencore, Orion Commodities, Alumax Materials, Sumitomo, Global Minerals & Metals, Commercial Alloys, Hunter Douglas, VAW, Alcoa, Tenneco Packaging, Gerald Metals and J. Pollack & Co.
